text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=rate-limiter-prod, severity=high, incident_id=PD-89421

pd-bot: @here PD incident PD-89421 created and paged OnCall. Summary: unexpected throttling after autoscaler event. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-89421 :rotating_light:

alice.oncall: acked PD-89421 :white_check_mark: picking up

alice.oncall: seeing 10s p95 spikes from limiter nodes, and 429s across multiple tenants. Logs show limiter pool resized just before spike.

bob.engops: are we seeing any deploys around that time?

carla.sre: checking deploys... nothing in the usual CI window. autoscaler did scale up limiter-pool-3 at 12:14:22 UTC.

eve.support: support dashboard: multiple customers reporting generative API 429s. Top impacted: AcmeCorp, NimbusApps. Ticket counts rising.

alice.oncall: quick impact check: ~2.3% of requests returning 429s globally across hosted API, concentrated in europe region. Latency also +200ms for valid requests.

carla.sre: digging into limiter logs, seeing inconsistent token-bucket state after hot-add of instances. Some instances report quota-map=default-tenant (i.e., lost tenant mapping). suspect config reload race.

bob.engops: if mapping fell back to default, single-bucket throttle could be applied across tenants -> explains broad 429s.

alice.oncall: mitigation plan: 1) pause autoscaler for limiter service, 2) force failover to limiter-primary (old stable pool), 3) enable temporary per-tenant uncapped window for top 20 customers while we fix mapping, 4) run origin rollback if needed. Doing steps 1-2 now.

carla.sre: step 1 done: autoscaler pause API called. step 2: triggering failover to limiter-primary via ops-runbook.

bob.engops: runbook command used: ```opsctl limiter failover --target=limiter-primary --force --dry-run=false```

pd-bot: PD incident PD-89421 acknowledged by alice.oncall at 12:20 UTC. Escalation to SRE manager in 8 minutes if not resolved.

eve.support: flagged high-severity incident on CS side, sending status update to impacted customers: "We're investigating increased rate limiting; our engineers are actively mitigating."

alice.oncall: failover completed at 12:23:14. Performing smoke tests...

carla.sre: smoke tests show 429 rate dropped to baseline (~0.03%). but a small subset of requests still get 429, looks like two nodes still have stale config. listing node IDs: limiter-3b, limiter-3c.

bob.engops: issuing remote restart on limiter-3b and limiter-3c. command: ```ssh ops@limiter-3b -- sudo systemctl restart limiterd && sudo journalctl -u limiterd -n 200```

alice.oncall: restart completed for both. monitoring for 10 minutes.

carla.sre: logs show config-reload error on previous hot-add path: "failed to hydrate tenant map: timeout reading config-store" followed by fallback to default mapping. Adding a short-term fix: increase config-store read timeout and add retry. will push a hotfix to limiter service config.

bob.engops: pushing hotfix config change now, will deploy to limiter-primary pool only (canary 10%). command: ```deployctl deploy --service limiter --image limiter:v2.3.1-hotfix --strategy=canary --percent=10```

alice.oncall: canary looks good for 5 minutes. no regression observed. rolling to 100% now.

pd-bot: PD-89421 updated: mitigation in progress, partial mitigation achieved, customer impact reduced.

eve.support: sent update to AcmeCorp and NimbusApps: "Intermittent throttling observed; mitigation in flight; we estimate <30 minutes to full recovery."

carla.sre: after full roll, config-store timeouts resolved and tenant mapping stable. root cause summary (prelim): race in limiter hot-add code path where config-store read used a short deadline; when autoscaler rapidly added instances during a traffic spike, some instances fell back to default mapping.

alice.oncall: post-mitigation checks: 429s back to baseline, p95 latency normalized. tagging incident as "mitigated". leaving PD incident open for postmortem until next morning.

bob.engops: created backup alert to detect "tenant-map fallback" events and added a runbook link. Alert rule: tenant_map_fallback_count > 0 for 60s -> page incidents channel.

eve.support: customer impact log: AcmeCorp reported 7 failing requests, NimbusApps 4, others minor. CS tickets created and linked to PD-89421.

carla.sre: handoff - I'm off at 18:00 UTC. @alice.oncall will coordinate full postmortem writeup, I'll add debug traces and reproduce steps tomorrow morning.

alice.oncall: ack. I'll own the postmortem and confirm rollout of permanent fix (patch in limiter code to use config-store client with backoff).

pd-bot: PD-89421: assigned -> alice.oncall, severity -> high, status -> mitigated (awaiting postmortem).

alice.oncall: final note: prevented broader customer impact via quick failover and targeted hotfix, but need engineering follow-up to harden autoscaler+hot-add path and add integration test. I'll open follow-up tickets. :memo:

incident-bot: closing thread (root message) — incident timeline saved to /incidents/PD-89421/timeline.json

alice.oncall: thanks everyone. I'll post the postmortem draft in #postmortems tomorrow for review. :pray:
